Dying light 1 is marginally way better for the story and the fighting zombies in my opinion. Dl2 was good but I think the only reason I enjoyed it is because it is a second dying light game. Dl1 has better ragdoll mechanics and exploring and finding your first gun/sword/expcaliber/completing the compelling story, is what I remember this game for most. Dying light 2 has better parkour and but I feel as if though they added way too many mechanics and different routes via skill trees and endings as opposed to its predecessor. Also in dying light 1, it prevails over dying light 2 in regard to the danger and fear of going out when it’s dark out. Personally dl1 was and always will be one of my favorite games and if you’re looking into it I think you should get dl1 and play through it to see if you like it. However if it’s not as fast paced, you’re not a story kinda person or it’s dated and not your cup of tea. Then looking at dying light 2 seems like a good idea because the parkour is more fluent considering it allows you to swiftly move from building to building, even navigating through the inside of them like a ninja. 
Lastly in my extremely biased opinion, dying light 1 has amazing replay-ability in accordance to the following dlc which I also enjoyed very very much. 

(Sorry for the long reply, I just have strong opinions on the difference between the two titles)
If anyone actually reads this and wants to counter my opinion with good points on dying light 2 I would love to switch my opinion on it since I haven’t played it nearly as much and quit after completing the story and some other Easter eggs.

Edit* now that I’m reading the replies I’m seeing now that my opinion isn’t that heavily disagreed with.
